prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution image of a hand sketching a pair of modern over-ear headphones on a clean white sheet of paper. The drawing is rendered in fine, precise pencil lines, with visible construction marks and geometric guidelines that emphasize the technical, design-oriented process. The headphones are depicted in a three-quarter view, showcasing their circular ear cups and padded headband, with careful attention to proportion and perspective. The hand, holding a mechanical pencil, is positioned in the lower right corner, mid-stroke, adding a sense of motion and creative engagement. The overall color palette is minimalistic, dominated by the stark contrast between the white background and the graphite lines, creating a crisp, professional, and slightly industrial aesthetic. The lighting is soft and even, eliminating harsh shadows and highlighting the clarity of the sketch. The composition is clean and focused, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the hand and drawing in sharp detail while subtly blurring the edges of the paper, evoking the meticulous atmosphere of an industrial designer’s workspace or an artist’s studio.
